defects: Mobile chart and table panels extend beyond the available width, clipping chart content and right-hand data columns.
The stacked mobile metric cards consume substantial space before the operational queues appear.
A8.note: A clear but fairly generic dashboard whose desktop organization does not translate reliably to the narrow screen.

defects: Mobile tables retain cramped desktop-style columns, with rightmost inventory and order details cut off.
The desktop section navigation disappears on mobile without a visible replacement.
U7.note: Strong exception-first organization makes the workday understandable, but the restrained visual identity and incomplete mobile tables limit readiness.

defects: The desktop sidebar navigation disappears on mobile without a visible menu replacement.
M5.note: A practical, legible operational dashboard with a comparatively successful mobile layout, though its visual treatment remains conventional.

defects: Mobile green-stock coverage figures extend beyond the right edge.
The mobile schedule and wholesale tables cut off rightmost columns rather than presenting all their data within the screen.
N6.note: The warm palette, live roast curve and detailed production data feel genuinely roastery-specific, but mobile overflow prevents a confident release.

defects: The mobile top navigation extends beyond the right edge, leaving later section links out of view.
The oversized desktop production chart pushes the roast schedule and wholesale queues below the initial viewport.
X7.note: Polished green-accented execution and mobile record cards make this a strong all-round dashboard despite a chart-heavy desktop hierarchy.

defects: Mobile roast-schedule and wholesale-order tables extend past their panels, clipping later columns.
The mobile section navigation is cut off on the right.
F2.note: Distinctive coffee-toned typography and an excellent stock-to-production-to-orders hierarchy make the desktop compelling, but mobile tables need reworking.

defects: The mobile wholesale-orders table has very narrow columns, wrapping customer names and dates across many lines.
H8.note: The most cohesive and purpose-built result combines confident editorial typography, live roasting context and a largely intact mobile operational overview.

defects: The mobile batch and wholesale panels remain side by side at roughly half-screen widths, leaving most table columns out of view.
The mobile inventory table clips its right-hand level and status information.
The mobile navigation extends beyond the right edge.
Q5.note: A competent, business-specific desktop dashboard is undermined by a severely compressed and clipped mobile layout.

defects: The mobile layout exceeds the viewport width, cropping the roast chart, telemetry values, stock-coverage labels and table columns.
The mobile wholesale table compresses customer names and coffee descriptions into narrow, heavily wrapped columns.
V3.note: An attractive, deeply roastery-specific live-roast view loses release readiness because its desktop-sized content is broadly cropped on mobile.
